definitions.explanation: Injuries of both kinds, serious and slight, counted together. A word of news reports on accidents and disasters, typically in {三人|さんにん}が{重軽傷|じゅうけいしょう}を{負|お}った (three people were injured, some seriously).

examples.japanese: ⟦{五人|ごにん}→五人：30567_gonin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{重軽傷|じゅうけいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}った→負う：02017_ou⟧。
examples.english: Five people were injured, some seriously.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦{十人|じゅうにん}→十人：28475_juunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{重軽傷|じゅうけいしょう}。
examples.english: Ten passengers injured, some seriously, in the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{歩道|ほどう}→歩道：03723_hodou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{突|つ}っ{込|こ}み→突っ込む：07000_tsukkomu⟧、⟦{歩行者|ほこうしゃ}→歩行者：03152_hokousha⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{重軽傷|じゅうけいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}った→負う：02017_ou⟧。
examples.english: A car plowed onto the sidewalk, injuring three pedestrians, some seriously.

notes:
Headline style often drops the verb: ⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧{重軽傷|じゅうけいしょう}. When the numbers are known separately, reports say ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重傷|じゅうしょう}→重傷：14414_juushou⟧、⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{軽傷|けいしょう}→軽傷：16546_keishou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {重軽傷|じゅうけいしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負|お}う→負う：02017_ou⟧: to suffer injuries, some serious
- {重軽傷|じゅうけいしょう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: the injured (serious and minor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重傷|じゅうしょう}→重傷：14414_juushou⟧: a serious injury
- ⟦{軽傷|けいしょう}→軽傷：16546_keishou⟧: a minor injury
- ⟦{重体|じゅうたい}→重体：01753_juutai⟧: critical condition — worse than ⟦{重傷|じゅうしょう}→重傷：14414_juushou⟧
